Messages.Author: Kulaid
Messages.Body:
brinkmanship is called and is on the table...

You have a barrens in play, and 7 cards in all...
On your untap, you start off with 7 cards...

Can you tap the barrens and attempt to withdraw with no fear of the
brinkmanship?

From the text, it'll seem if you have less then a full hand, you are
forced to withdraw... If your forced to withdraw and fail, you are
ousted... But it'll all about the rulings...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:
> brinkmanship is called and is on the table...
>
> You have a barrens in play, and 7 cards in all...
> On your untap, you start off with 7 cards...
>
> Can you tap the barrens and attempt to withdraw with no fear of the
> brinkmanship?

No. You can tap the Barrens, but you cannot attempt to withdraw. [9.2]

> From the text, it'll seem if you have less then a full hand, you are
> forced to withdraw...

If you have less than a full hand at the start of your turn (as required
by section 9.2 for attempts to withdraw at all) ...

This is true. Card text.

If you have a full hand at the start of your turn, you cannot withdraw
and Brinksmanship doesn't force you to.

> If your forced to withdraw and fail, you are
> ousted...

Correct.

> But it'll all about the rulings...

Just card text and section 9.2 in this case.
